subject.title: [Feature]: Add Korean (ko) language support to Control UI and AI agent

question: Should OpenClaw core automatically preserve the user's detected language and apply Korean-aware search defaults, or should language choice remain user/prompt/tool controlled beyond the shipped UI locale?
rationale: Current source already solves the Control UI localization request, but changing default assistant prompt and search-language behavior affects all users and mixed-language/provider semantics, so automation should not choose that policy.

options.title: Require a narrow policy proposal first
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored agent/search language policy after a redacted Korean transcript proves the remaining behavior and tests define the intended scope.

options.title: Scope this to UI localization only
options.body: Treat Korean Control UI support as complete and explicitly decline automatic agent/search language behavior for now.

options.title: Adopt global same-language behavior
options.body: Approve a focused implementation that adds default same-language prompt/search behavior with coverage for mixed-language and opt-out cases.

recommendation.title: Require a narrow policy proposal first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored agent/search language policy after a redacted Korean transcript proves the remaining behavior and tests define the intended scope.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest history signal for the i18n pipeline and already made the related PR's scope decision.
